subject: ISV collaboration summit: Orchestrator sandbox & trace hooks
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Sasha Lee <sasha@orchestratorlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@acme-integrations.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ISV collaboration summit: Orchestrator sandbox & trace hooks

Hi Sasha / Orchestrator team,

Following up on last week's intro: we'd like to host a short co-engineering summit the week of Oct 12 to align on (1) co-hosted sandbox environment for your SDK, (2) trace hook integration for prompt/response telemetry, and (3) an end-to-end acceptance checklist for instrumented runtimes.

Proposed agenda (60-90m):
- Quick intros & success metrics (10m)
- Sandbox topology & access (15m)
- Trace hook API contract + telemetry mapping (25m)
- Acceptance criteria & next steps + owners (10-15m)

I've attached a draft agenda and a short sandbox access doc. Marcus — can you confirm Redwood infra availability for Oct 12-14? Vanessa — can your partner ops rep join? Sasha / Ben — any conflicts with those dates?

Goals: engineerable artifacts by the end of the sprint (sandbox creds, trace shim PR, acceptance test list) so we can roll into a pilot with one mutual customer in November.

Thanks,

--
Marissa Cole
Partner Engineering Lead
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
<attachment: orch_summit_agenda_v1.pdf (PDF, 180KB)>

From: Sasha Lee <sasha@orchestratorlabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Orchestrator Labs Partnerships <partner@orchestratorlabs.com>, Ben Carter <ben@acme-integrations.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ISV collaboration summit: Orchestrator sandbox & trace hooks

Marissa — thanks, excited to get this moving. Oct 12 is challenging for our engineering lead (on a field trip) but Oct 13 or 14 works. Our priorities line up with the agenda. Two quick asks up front:

1) Sandbox: we prefer a short-lived co-hosted environment that mirrors customer load (small qps, token caps). Can Redwood provision a tenant we can seed with our integration tests?

2) Trace hooks: we use a lightweight SDK that emits event batches; we'll need a mapping doc for Redwood's telemetry semantics (token attribution, call_id, prompt_hash).

Ben from Acme will observe — he's helping us validate deployment patterns with customers. We'll block Oct 13 10-11am PT for now.

Cheers,
Sasha
Sasha Lee
Head of Partnerships
Orchestrator Labs
sasha@orchestratorlabs.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Lee <sasha@orchestratorlabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ISV collaboration summit: Orchestrator sandbox & trace hooks

Thanks — Oct 13 10-11am PT works for Redwood. Logistics below.

Summary & owners: 
- Sandbox tenant: Redwood will provision a restricted dedicated tenant in the us-west-2 region (owner: Infrastructure — me). Expect creds + tenancy GUID 48 hours before the summit.
- Trace mapping doc: Marissa will circulate a telemetry mapping template. Orchestrator to annotate SDK events to Redwood fields (call_id, token_counts, prompt_slot).
- Acceptance tests: Vanessa will own the customer-facing checklist and CS handoff.

Attachments: sandbox-access-instructions.txt includes ephemeral SSH/key instructions and rate-limits. Please treat the tenant as a shared test environment — no PII.

Next steps:
- Marissa: finalize agenda + telemetry template by Oct 4
- Sasha: confirm SDK owners who will join the summit (names + emails)
- Vanessa: draft acceptance checklist by Oct 6

If anything changes, reply-all. See you Oct 13 — remote link to follow.

--
Marcus Lin
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Integrations
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
<attachment: sandbox-access-instructions.txt (TXT, 2KB)>
